name: aigpu-b2-dual
description: Pre-silicon target architecture profile: AI-GPU B2 Dual-Die CoWoS-L / UCIe 2.0 unified coherent 256-core datacenter AI GPU (2 x aigpu-b2 dies = 16 clusters x 16 RV64X cores, 256 MiB unified L2, 8.0 TB/s HBM3E; NOT measured physical silicon).

sources.evidence_status: PRE-SILICON TARGET ARCHITECTURE PROFILE ONLY: not measured physical silicon, not physical FPGA hardware, and not full-package foundry sign-off. Models a dual-die CoWoS-L coherent logical GPU unifying two aigpu-b2 dies over UCIe 2.0 D2D.
sources.extends: Inherits core RV64X + TFR/WGMMA FEDP2K PE_RATIO=1 + DXA + MUFU configuration from profiles/aigpu-b2.json.
sources.NUM_CLUSTERS, NUM_CORES: 16 clusters x 16 cores per cluster = 256 cores across 2 coherent dies (2 x ~780 mm^2 CoWoS-L package) connected via 10 TB/s bidirectional UCIe 2.0 coherent D2D link and 64 MiB aggregate TMEM (32 MiB/die).
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_BANKS: 256 MiB unified coherent L2/SLC (268435456 B across 16 distributed MOESI directory slices, 16 ways, 128 banks) with 256B-interleaved dual-die address hashing.
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_PEA: Pre-silicon architectural target: modeled 2000 MHz core clock and 16-stack HBM3E 8,000 GB/s (8000000 MB/s) aggregate bandwidth modeled on Vortex's HBM3 enum across 128 power-of-two 128-bit pseudo-channels at 3906 MT/s; B2 TFRv2 architectural target is 2,304 TFLOPS FP16 / 4,608 TFLOPS FP8 / 9,216 TOPS FP4 dense (2x with 2:4 sparsity).
sources.reference: Modeled analytical pre-silicon target figures (fp32_lanes=32768, dram_bandwidth_gbs=8000, dram_peak_bytes_per_cycle=4000, clock_mhz=2000, num_cores=256, l2_size_mib=256, tcu_blocks_total=1024) checked by ci/profile_check.py --metrics=peak. Explicitly NOT physical silicon measurements.
